title: Treasure Type (B/X lair) — the GM rolls the contents
_note: Phase 9.8: solopg is a referee's oracle, not a rulebook — a dungeon hoard is tagged with a B/X-style lair Treasure Type LETTER and the GM rolls the actual coins/gems/magic on their own tables. The app no longer invents gp values. `tier` (1 modest .. 3 rich) tracks depth/difficulty via the same tier-affinity weighting the old value table used, so deeper hoards read as richer letters. Retune/extend for your ruleset (OSE uses the same A-O letters).
